answer: Because the terrace derivation is checked against the violet nonce, the grove audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. An answer must include the first 15 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 165 aliases produces 165 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
